summary: Assess PPA risks, test tariff assumptions and prepare negotiation positions through practical contract and cash-flow exercises. View the course outline.
lede: Power purchase agreement training helps project developers, finance analysts and contract professionals assess contract exposure and its effect on project cash flows. Participants map payment, generation and curtailment risks, assess tariff assumptions and run cash-flow and DSCR sensitivities in Excel. They also prepare clause-level risk-allocation matrices and negotiation positions with fallback options.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who assess, price, negotiate or oversee power purchase agreements and their project-finance implications.
prerequisites: Working familiarity with energy project development, power contracts or project-finance analysis is recommended. No programming is required; exercises use spreadsheet calculations and contract scenarios.
